items.ytTitle: Closed the Terminal? Your Claude Session Isn't Gone
items.caption:
You closed the terminal. Two hours of explaining, gone.

Except it wasn't. Claude Code saves your conversations locally.

Anthropic's own docs: when a task spans several sittings, you don't have to re-explain the context.

The fix:
1. claude --continue picks up your last conversation, right where you left off.
2. claude --resume shows a list so you can pick an older one.
3. Give sessions descriptive names (like oauth-migration) so you can find them later.

Save this for the next time you close the wrong window.

Follow @claude.cheats for more.

items.ytTitle: Claude Started Coding Before You Finished (Use Plan Mode)
items.caption:
You typed half a sentence. Claude already changed twelve files.

It's not being rude. Nobody told it to read first.

Anthropic's own Claude Code docs: use plan mode to separate exploration from execution. Explore, then plan, then code.

The fix:
1. Press Shift+Tab until the status bar says plan mode.
2. Claude reads files and answers questions, but can't edit anything.
3. It writes a plan. You approve it. Then it codes.

The rule: big change across many files? Plan mode. If you could describe the change in one sentence, skip the plan and just ask.

Follow @claude.cheats for more.

#claudecode #claudeai #claude #aitools #developertools #vibecoding #productivity #claudecheats

items.ytTitle: Claude Fixed the Same Bug 6 Times (Here's the Real Fix)
items.caption:
Claude fixed the same bug six times. It's still broken.

It's not being dim. Every failed fix is still sitting in the chat, and Claude keeps building on top of them.

Anthropic's own Claude Code docs: corrected Claude more than twice on the same issue? The context is cluttered with failed approaches.

The fix:
1. Two wrong fixes? Type /clear.
2. Start fresh and tell it what you learned ("it only breaks after midnight UTC").
3. Just one wrong turn? Press Esc twice to rewind instead.

Save this for the next time it says "Fixed!" 🔁

Follow @claude.cheats for more.
